voon_diagnostics.scope: Fake libraries and in-memory SQLite only. No GUI, actual SMB fault, actual audio decoding, real NAS or user database.

Cargo.toml.text:
[package]
name = "voon-library-diagnostics"
version = "0.0.0"
edition = "2024"
publish = false

[dependencies]
voon-core = { path = "/Users/liujun/Private/Code/github/voon/crates/voon-core" }

RUN_COMMAND.txt.text:
Seed the standalone crate with the repository lockfile (only the temporary copy is updated):

cp /Users/liujun/Private/Code/github/voon/Cargo.lock /private/tmp/voon-roon-analysis/repro/Cargo.lock

Run the diagnostic executable entirely offline, reusing the repository's existing target cache:

CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/Users/liujun/Private/Code/github/voon/target cargo run --manifest-path /private/tmp/voon-roon-analysis/repro/Cargo.toml --offline > /private/tmp/voon-roon-analysis/repro/stdout.txt 2> /private/tmp/voon-roon-analysis/repro/stderr.txt

The program uses in-memory SQLite databases, creates uniquely named fake music libraries under this repro directory, and restores the directory permission changed by experiment 1.
